history_anchors._doc: ~1950/51: Viggo Nielsen founds Bari Piber in KOLDING. Sons Kai + Jørgen Nielsen work there until 1975 (Kai Nielsen later independent — artisan link). Bari rides the Stanwell-led 'Danish Design' wave with series pipes: machine-roughed, hand-finished — solid everyday pipes, no highgrades. 1978: Viggo sells to Joh. Wilh. von EICKEN GmbH (Hamburg); 33 employees at sale. 1978-1993: Åge Bogelund + Helmer Thomsen head production (Bogelund also made respectable freehands; trail lost after 1993). 1993: THOMSEN buys the company -> renamed 'BARI PIBER HELMER THOMSEN', workshop moves to VEJEN. Famous series: smooth 'Classic Diamond', blasted 'WIKING' (also 'Viking Classic' spelling). Seconds: 'Excellent' + 'DON' (source flags the attribution as unproven; Excellent = Oldenkott sub-brand too!).

brand_marks.physical: Series stamps: Bari + line name (Classic Diamond, Wiking, Amber, Renomee, Ruby, Select Nature, Senior, Matador, Mandarin, Handcut...). Post-1993 wording: 'Bari Piber Helmer Thomsen'.
